scripts.dev: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo dev
scripts.build: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo build
scripts.generate: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo generate
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && cd apps/desktop && go test ./...
scripts.lint: eslint . && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm lint:go && pnpm lint:dup
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --fix && pnpm fmt && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint fmt && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint run --fix
scripts.lint:go: go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint fmt --diff && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint run

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm exec lint-staged && pnpm exec jscpd --silent && pnpm exec knip
